title: Mrs. Clementin's dancing: mazurkas, scallops and halls
summary: She recalls dancing the mazurka and round dances at Lincoln Park after marriage, a hall on Rampart, trolley rides, and the Creole Fiesta Association.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the numbers they played?
The numbers they played? Yeah. Oh, I tell ya, Missouri was born. I had to start with walls. Missouri was... That's why we danced at Hyman Park right here. Uh-huh. Yeah. After we was married.
After you were married, you went into Lincoln Park?
Yeah, I went to Lincoln Park. And me and I danced in Missouri. Missouri was.
Oh, yeah.

On the roof guard?
On the roof guard. On the roof guard. Uh-huh.
Well, you could just hop on the two-lane bell, aren't you? Yeah, on the two-lane bell.
